seasonPassCard: Vampire Killmonger (2-Cost, 2-Power, Series 5 Premium Season Pass, season begins Oct 6, 2026. End of Turn: If you spent all your Energy, get a Vampiric Spear -- Vampiric Spear is On Reveal: steal 2 Power from a character in your opponent's hand. Cost/Power cross-verified via marvelsnapzone.com's card page and its unreleased-cards listing, plus snapcomplete.com. Note: the Super Premium track's card this season is Zombie Blade, 2-Cost/3-Power, End of Turn: If you played an On Reveal, your Zombie Horde steals 1 Power from a character in your opponent's hand -- also cross-verified via marvelsnapzone.com and snapcomplete.com. recentOTA: Thanos Fractured Frontier: reworked (Oct 1 OTA, nerf) -- Quickdraw no longer pre-loads an Infinity Shot at game start; it now loads one Infinity Shot per Quickdraw trigger instead. Per marvelsnap.com, the developers expected chaining this turn over turn to be harder than it turned out to be; it had become the undisputed best card in the game. Cross-verified marvelsnap.com + marvelsnapzone.com.
Domino: 2/4 -> 2/3 (nerf, Oct 1 OTA)
Jane Foster Fractured Frontier: 3/4 -> 3/3 (nerf, Oct 1 OTA, aimed at the Curved High Evolutionary / Ongoing Affliction synergy)
Tao Mandala (The Ancient One, location): 2-Cost -> 3-Cost (nerf, Oct 1 OTA)
Blink: 5/7 -> 5/8, and can now swap with cards costing the same or more Energy (previously only strictly more) (buff, Oct 1 OTA)
Zombie Captain Marvel: 4/5 -> 4/6 (buff, Oct 1 OTA)
Winter Soldier (Bucky Barnes): 2/7 -> 2/8 (buff, Oct 1 OTA)
Tombstone: 2/4 -> 2/5 (buff, Oct 1 OTA)
Kluh: 5/10 -> 5/11 (buff, Oct 1 OTA; second consecutive buff after the Sept 10 OTA below)
Basic Arrow (Hawkeye: Kate Bishop): +3 Power -> +4 Power bonus on reveal (buff, Oct 1 OTA, restoring strength to a fan-favorite that had fallen off)
Hellcow Fractured Frontier: text clarified to add 'Other' so it cannot destroy itself (Oct 1 OTA, no functional balance change)
Venus: 3/3 -> 3/2 (nerf, Sept 10 OTA; per marvelsnap.com, 'likely the strongest 3-Cost card in the game')
Scorpion: Brand New Day: 6/8 -> 6/6 (nerf, Sept 10 OTA, 'the strongest non-interactive deck in the metagame')
Blink: 5/8 -> 5/7 (nerf, Sept 10 OTA; note this was buffed back to 5/8 plus a text change in the Oct 1 OTA above)
Isca the Unbeaten: 4/3 -> 4/2 (nerf, Sept 10 OTA, 'solos a location by itself too often without much further investment')
Gambit: Horseman of Death: 3/5 -> 4/6 (nerf, Sept 10 OTA; Cost raised, not just Power, to curb excessive matchup variance from the repeatable ability)
Nicholas Scratch: 1/2 -> 1/3 (buff, Sept 10 OTA)
Vulture: move-trigger power bonus +3 -> +4 (buff, Sept 10 OTA)
The Collector: 2/2 -> 2/3 (buff, Sept 10 OTA)
Spider-Sense: Cost reduced 6 -> 5 (buff, Sept 10 OTA)
Superior Iron Man: 5/7 -> 5/8 (buff, Sept 10 OTA)
Mister Fantastic: First Steps: +2 Power -> +3 Power bonus (buff, Sept 10 OTA)
Majestic Wingbeat: +2 Power -> +3 Power bonus (buff, Sept 10 OTA)

NOTE: the Sept 15 patch (v57.x) was feature/progression only -- Character Mastery reward-track overhaul, Cubes now earnable from free reward tracks in limited-time modes, Draft Mode's Sept 28 return with Sanctum Showdown-style scoring plus 4 new Draft augments (Apex, Unstoppable, Taunt, Slingshot), and a cosmetic-only 'Start of Turn:' keyword-wording consistency pass on Entropic Havok, Jim Hammond Human Torch, Kitty Pryde, Mad Thinker, Merlin, Superior Spider-Man, Viv Vision, Ice Cube, Professor X, and Wolverine ('no functionality has changed'). No card balance changes in that patch, so it is omitted above. Both the Sept 10 and Oct 1 OTAs above are cross-verified against marvelsnap.com (primary) and marvelsnapzone.com (secondary); figures matched exactly on both.

topArchetypes.name: Curved 4-Costs
topArchetypes.description: The #1 deck per the Oct 5, 2026 marvelsnapzone.com Ranked Meta Tier List (Axis: Inversion Final Week snapshot): 62.5% win rate / 0.55 avg cubes, built around Quicksilver, Domino, Caliban Horseman of Pestilence, Jubilee, Captain Marvel, En Sabah Nur plus the season's Anti-Polar Magneto and Rogue: Scion of Division pickups. Cross-verified from an unrelated dataset: snapcomplete.com's independent card-win-rate tracker (20,698 synced players) separately lists Caliban Horseman of Pestilence and En Sabah Nur among the single highest drawn-win-rate cards in the game (59.5% and 58.9%).

topArchetypes.name: Created Chaos
topArchetypes.description: Second place in the same Oct 5 snapshot at 57.5% win rate / 0.5 avg cubes -- a random-generation shell running Majestic Wingbeat, Quinjet, Maria Hill, Iron Patriot, Valentina, Shadow King, Mother Askani, and Gambit Horseman of Death. snapcomplete.com's independent card tracker also flags Majestic Wingbeat as a top performer (52.0% drawn win rate across 33,683 games, the largest sample of any card tracked), corroborating the deck's strength from a second dataset.

topArchetypes.name: Curved Disruption / Curved High Evolutionary
topArchetypes.description: Two of five Tier 2 decks in the Oct 5 snapshot (60% and 59.5% win rate respectively). Curved High Evolutionary carried its Thanos Fractured Frontier + Jane Foster Fractured Frontier Ongoing Affliction synergy through the Oct 1 OTA nerf largely unscathed -- marvelsnapzone.com's own OTA analysis states the deck 'barely noticed the nerf' since it still runs both pieces alongside the High Evolutionary / Abomination discount engine.
